title: The final connector Docker image stays under the 100MB budget
description: Wiki §15's budget; CI's image-size-budget job builds the image and fails with an explicit error if it reaches 100MB.
preconditions: A clean build of the real Dockerfile
expectedResult: Size is comfortably under 100MB (measured 35.2MB at Task 8.3 completion); CI fails the build if this regresses to/past 100MB.

title: vtec_pipeline_stage_duration_seconds records a real observation for all 9 stages, including Upload
description: Stage 9 (Upload) lives outside pipeline.Pipeline's synchronous chain but observes into the same shared histogram under its own label.
preconditions: A live connector completing at least one full collection+upload cycle
steps: Scrape vtec_pipeline_stage_duration_seconds_count for each of the 9 stage labels
expectedResult: All 9 stages (normalize, filter, dedupe, mask, enrich, compress, encrypt, queue, upload) show a non-zero observation count.

title: The disk-capacity backlog alert fires before the 5GB cap is reached, not only after
description: VTECQueueBacklog's disk-based variant thresholds at 4GiB (80% of the 5GiB default cap) specifically to warn before the buffer actually fills and JetStream's DiscardNew policy starts silently dropping new evidence.
preconditions: A promtool test simulating vtec_queue_disk_bytes_used at 4.5GiB for 15+ minutes
steps: Run promtool test rules against the disk-capacity scenario
expectedResult: The alert fires at the 4GiB threshold, well before the hard 5GB cap where evidence would start being discarded.

title: Heartbeat/metrics sampling adds no observable CPU overhead spike on the very first sample
description: Regression-adjacent performance check: ProcessMetricsSource's baseline-at-construction fix prevents a nonsense thousands-of-percent CPU spike on the first heartbeat.
steps: Capture the very first heartbeat's cpu_percent value
expectedResult: The value is a small, plausible percentage — not an outlier spike distorting the first dashboard reading.

title: The fleet dashboard's auto-refresh does not produce a visible layout thrash or duplicate network storm
preconditions: The fleet dashboard open with several connectors, left running for multiple refresh cycles
steps: Observe the Network tab across several 8-second poll intervals
Observe the table for visible re-render flicker
expectedResult: Exactly one GET /connectors and one GET /fleet/health call per interval; no overlapping/duplicate in-flight requests; no visible flicker of unrelated rows.

title: Evidence compression ratio reflects genuine zstd compression of real content, not a fixed value
preconditions: Real, repetitive fixture evidence content collected by the SQL adapter
steps: Collect and compress the same real content across several cycles
Compare CompressionRatio values against the plaintext size
expectedResult: The ratio scales sensibly with actual content characteristics — confirming a real zstd pass, not a hardcoded constant.
